title: PrivacySessionRecordFailure - Data API
description: Represents error messages encountered during policy job executions in Privacy Center. This object is available in API version 59.0 and later.

ErrorMessage.description: The description of the error encountered during the policy job execution.

ErrorType.description: The type of error encountered during the policy job execution.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Represents the job session record. This is a serialized, automatically generated number field.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with the customer that the policy was executed for. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PrivacyObjectSessionId.description: The ID of the object in the policy job session. This field is a relationship field.

RecordIdNumber.description: The ID of the record that failed to be processed by the policy job.

special_access_rules:
